text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So right now, I'm trying to think of an 
"epithet" for myself! Something cool, like 
"Empress" or "Crystal of Blood" just like 
you two!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Such things are meant to be bestowed by 
'others' who have witnessed one's way of 
life. Doesn't coming up with it oneself 
somewhat defeat the purpose?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! W-Well, that may be true, but...! No, 
but still!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
An alias is, in essence—a concept! The 
core of any creative work! The ultimate 
destination of the piece!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"For example... What's usually on your 
mind when you run?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Naturally... I intend to prove it. That 
the blood of the clan flowing through my 
veins—is the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's it, that's it! Because you ran with 
that kind of resolve, the people watching 
called it 'crystallized blood'! That's 
what it means!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The determination to make the readers feel 
a certain way! That's what a concept is 
all about!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Coming up with your own nickname 
means defining your own way of life—a 
concept that proves your resolve for how 
you're going to run! That's what it is!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see, it truly is profound... So, what 
kind of ideas are you considering now?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm so glad you asked! 'The 
Unpredictable Creator Who Conquered the 
World'—!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe! 'The God of Epic Battles'! 'The 
Hitmaker Who Shook the Entire World'! And 
what else, what else~...!
